line_text: The Archadians... A Judge, leading armed men... Those who went to stop them, slain, every one! / You and the Lady Ashe... Quickly, you must leave... The temple—they are there still... / We began speaking with the Archadian forces that arrived, when the Judge, he suddenly drew his blade... / That man...a monster! So many people... felled with but a single blow... / You must not go near the temple! The Judge, he is still there... His Grace Anastasis attempts to reason with him within... / That they would profane the holy mountain of the Kiltias so! Has Archadia no fear of the gods? / The Judge cut down all Kiltias who tried to stop him, and profaned the temple... I pray His Grace is unharmed... / Just when I began to grow close to them, they started killing each other. It is as I feared... Hume behavior is savage and ugly. / The Fates have brought you to us once again. You have come for the Piscodaemon? (choices: That is correct. / Not so.) / Hrmm... That which you must slay was one gifted with great magickal powers, yet he wanted more, and so fell into darkness. He shares the name Ashkroft...he is my twin. Drunk on his own power, the darkness stole his heart. So did His Grace Anastasis cast him out. This was ten years ago. In his wisdom, Anastasis laid a veil upon my brother's memories. Yet, with Anastasis's death, the veil was lifted. My brother began to visit me in dreams, not as he was in life, but as the horrible Piscodaemon, wandering the wilds. In my dream, I saw where he wanders! He goes to the forbidden holy land of Giruvegan! He passes the Gate of Fire, he seeks to consort with the Undying! Please, defeat him before it is too late. Save my brother's soul. / ...I see. I am sorry. I thought I spied the work of the Fates in this. I was mistaken. / The Fates are kind, perhaps? You have come for the Piscodaemon? (choices: That is correct. / Not so.) / I can see him, my brother, fallen on the dark ways... Become the Piscodaemon, he passes the Gate of Fire! / So...you have saved the soul of my brother. In his place, I thank you. You are strong indeed... ...But do not fall victim to your own strength, or your companions will know the same despair as I. Do not become as my brother. / Do not fall victim to your own strength, or your companions will know the same despair as I. Do not become as my brother. / You have slain Fafnir! How long it took His Grace Anastasis to quell that fearsome wyrm... You have grown strong beyond compare, yet do not allow your strength to intoxicate you. Many are they destroyed by their own overreaching power. / With the passing of His Grace Anastasis, the future of the Kiltias is shrouded in darkness. I pray the Light will cut through these clouds... / All Mt Bur-Omisace mourns the passing of His Grace the Gran Kiltias. Yet our grief shall flow together, and we shall rise again. Faram. / All Bur-Omisace mourns the passing of His Grace Anastasis. Now it falls to us to choose another Gran Kiltias, yet no one steps forward... I fear the future of the Kiltias is imperiled. / Even should hardships fall like summer rains, the sun shall return and shine down upon us. Gods give us Light. Faram. / Should the Archadians come again, what will become of us? We have no strength to resist an attack. Light's mercy on us all. Faram. / The blessing of the gods is needed ever more as Ivalice draws closer to war. We keep the faith, that we might aid the many who come to us. / You have the look of one who knows many technicks. But did you know that some technicks alter their range with different weapons? For instance, were you to use Souleater upon a winged foe, a sword would not avail you, yet a bow would serve in good stead. A good grasp of the situation is essential to prevailing in combat. / Relj's heart, burdened with doubt, was saved by Ieeha's sacrifice. Sometimes, the dead can give guidance to the living. / You go to the Imperial City of Archades? Hrmm... It would not do to travel on foot. I recommend chocobo, or perhaps a gate crystal. / In the depths of a forest enshrouded by Mist and snowstorm lies the legendary city of the ancient gods. I have not seen it, mind you. / NOT USED bul_a03 / NOT USED bul_a03 / Hume-child, do you seek greater power? Know, then, the fate of those who have fallen in their search for strength. In the distant past, the great Condemner, too, sought such power, and was stricken down by the gods. Even now, his spirit is bound within the Stilshrine of Miriam. ...Take this stone in hand, and walk the paths into darkness. / Yes, hume-child, walk with Zeromus. His very presence should serve as a reminder of the fate of those drunk on power. / In the distant past, the great Condemner, too, sought such power, and was stricken down by the gods. Even now, his spirit is bound within the Stilshrine of Miriam. Know the fate of those who have fallen in their search for strength. / The Gran Kiltias can see the future with his dreamsight. Perhaps he may read the future invested in you? / Ah, a pilgrim. Continue on to reach the Hall of the Light, where presides His Grace the Gran Kiltias Anastasis. / What words did His Grace share with you? Do not forget them, even be their meaning unclear to you now. / Up the steps you'll find the Hall of the Light, where presides His Grace, Anastasis. / South through the Paramina Rift you'll find the Stilshrine of Miriam, but there are many fiends along the way. The Light protect you. Faram. / I ask that you remain quiet while in the Hall of the Light. His Grace is a dreamsage, and must have silence. Do not disturb his meditation. / Can't fly in jagd so I came by ship, but the view from here was worth the long journey. I'm no believer, but this place is impressive. / The old and wise nu mou elders teach us Kiltias. Simply speaking with them is a revelation. / You go to the Stilshrine of Miriam? Then go prepared. The ice of Paramina Rift is treacherous and unforgiving. / Welcome to Mt Bur-Omisace, holy mountain of the Kiltias. May I ask why you've come to us? (choices: On pilgrimage. / As refugees.) / I see. All are welcome here. Through these temple grounds you will find the sanctum where the Gran Kiltias Anastasis presides. / I see. All are welcome here. However, this is the way to the temple where the Gran Kiltias Anastasis presides. The Kiltias tend to refugees beside the road by which you came. / We cannot feed the refugees indefinitely, but must give them the means to feed themselves. If only one could magick foodstuffs... / My sleep is oft troubled of late. I pray 'tis merely the nerves of an old man. Light guide your path. Faram. / You go to the Stilshrine to claim the Sword of Kings? So, the power that King Raithwall gave the Kiltias shall once more grace history's stage. Though we maintain the entrance to the Stil- shrine of Miriam, the interior is the demesne of fiends ancient and powerful. Be wary, friend. / Ah, you are in Lord Larsa's party, yes? The Gran Kiltias awaits within. You shall find him through these doors. / Every day we welcome more refugees seeking the protection of the Kiltias, and our capacity to feed and shelter them grows ever more strained. / We Kiltias live on the gifts of believers. In the past, Nabradia and Dalmasca, too, gave generously, but those days are no more. / The words of His Grace Anastasis are a path to salvation. Carry them in your heart, let them guide you. Light shine upon you. Faram. / The building ahead is the main temple. Within you shall find the Hall of the Light where His Grace Anastasis presides. / The elders are concerned about the future of our mountain. Are the ever-swelling waves of refugees a sign of more evil to come? Faram. / The islands floating in the sky are said to be the remains of a great sky continent, shattered and fallen long ago. Even now, they bleed power, robbing airships of their buoyancy. / Mt Bur-Omisace is protected by the holy power of His Grace the Gran Kiltias. Once, long ago, a great wyrm, filled with avarice, sought to steal the riches of our mountain, but His Grace drove it off to Paramina. / You have the look of one who knows many technicks. But did you know that some technicks alter their range with different weapons? For instance, were you to use Souleater upon a winged foe, a sword would not avail you, yet a bow would serve in good stead. A good grasp of the situation is essential to prevailing in combat. / The refugees' numbers are growing, while the pilgrims' decrease. It is sad. I would think the faith vital in times such as these. / Alone... Leave me alone. The hearts of humes are weak. I dare not grow close to them, lest mine grow weak as well. / Alone...? Relj, do not say such things!

speaker: Refugee; Kiltias; Wounded Refugee; Relj; Ieeha
line_text: There are still Imperials up in the temple. I'd stay clear of the place, were I you. / The Kiltias, they tried to stop the soldiers. The Imperials set fire to our tents as punishment. / Our home...our home... / Those Judges...I thought they were protectors of the law, but they are only cruel brutes, bullying the weak. / Mama was standing with the Kiltias, and the man in armor knocked her down! She can't get up for the pain... Mama! / I've been separated from my family. Gods, I hope they're all right! / Relj is aiding the reconstruction! We, too, shall lend a hand. This is our home now, after all. / There's an ailment called "disease," very nasty. Once you get that in your system, your wounds... they won't heal. I've heard of people who fought on, even while diseased, till there weren't nothin' left to heal. It's enough to make you want to stay at home. / There is smoke, but our homes no longer burn. They're burning the wreckage left by the destruction. / No one here has the strength to douse what remains of the fires. I wish it would all burn away, not smoke and sputter so. / To see a viera working alongside humes...it is a rare sight, indeed. Perhaps this, too, is a miracle of the holy mountain. / This rain...do the gods weep? If they've time to weep, they've time to come down here and start saving us. / (empty string) / The holy mountain was greatly damaged in the Archadian attack. It falls to us who remain to rebuild... / Relj will teach me the preparation of medicinal herbs. I can think of no better way to aid my fellow refugees. / I would leave for Rabanastre, but to pass through the rift, the viera's Wood, Ozmone Plain, and Giza... I would not survive the trip. / My mama's all better after Relj gave her some medicine! / No, Mama, no! You mustn't die, you can't! Don't leave me! Mama...! / Many died fighting a terrible wyrm that attacked the mountain... I will defend Bur-Omisace in their memory. / As soon as I am mended, I shall leave this place. I wouldn't stay here if they made me Gran Kiltias. / You have seen 's posting? (choices: Yes / No) / Then I must tell you, Ieeha is no longer here. You have read in the bill that the terrible wyrm Fafnir plagues Paramina Rift? In times past, the wyrm came, lusting for the treasures of the Kiltias. Anastasis trapped it in ice, yet now it threatens the mountain again. Ieeha has led the Kiltias to defeat it once again...or so he said. I believe he has merely fled. Humes are this way. Be that as it may, it is no matter to me. Ieeha is gone, so I have told you of the wyrm in his place. Do as you wish. / Then leave me be. I am pleased to speak with your kind as little as possible. / Then you did see Ieeha's posting? (choices: Yes / No) / In times past, a fell wyrm came, lusting for the treasures of the Kiltias. Anastasis trapped it in ice, yet now it threatens the mountain again. At Silverflow's End, deep within Paramina Rift, lies the den of the wyrm Fafnir. It is said a blizzard follows in its wake... Or perhaps it is the blizzard. Either way, it is no matter to me. Ieeha is gone, so I have told you of the wyrm in his place. Do as you wish. / This...this is Ieeha's ring! Then he did do battle with Fafnir! But why? He knew he could not win! / ...I left the viera homeland, I broke our laws, because I wanted to know why the humes prospered over all other races of Ivalice. So did I journey...yet I found the world of the humes engulfed in horrible war. / Many times was I betrayed, disappointed, wounded. And when at last I came to Bur-Omisace I found only weak humes, clinging to their gods. / ...Only now do I realize. It is because they are weak that the humes support one another. / They accept, forgive, aid, and will fight to the death to protect their own... This is their strength. Thus do the humes prosper. / I thank you, hume traveler. With your retrieval of Ieeha's ring, you have answered the questions that sent me from my home. I wander Ivalice no more. I will remain here, in this place, and honor the memory of Ieeha, who died to protect the mountain he loved. / I teach the people here the herb-lore known to my village. The Kiltias defend this mountain with their lives, and I would aid them. / I turned my back on my home to see the world of the humes, and what I found was slaughter and despicable weakness. / Relj's heart seemed closed to us, yet she has come to our aid in a time of great need. Ieeha's wish came true. / Relj, do not say these things. If you find humes weak, then lend us your strength! Bereft of His Grace Anastasis's protection, Mt Bur-Omisace is vulnerable. Even now, a terrible wyrm rages near. Many have fallen... / I was set upon by fiends in Paramina Rift, when the Kiltias saved me! I owe them my life. / We are refugees from the Republic of Landis, fallen to the Empire long ago...before you were born, son. When we first came here, there were few of us enough. Now, the fires of war rage outside, and we are close to overflowing. / This is not the best land upon which to make a living, but here we are safe from armies and fiends. That is enough. / Ah, a new arrival? Don't worry, no need to jump the queue here. There's food enough for all. / Me? I was born in Nabradia. My village was burned to the ground in the war two years ago, and I made my way here. I envy you Dalmascan folk. Even an occupation's better than seeing your home and everything you loved reduced to a pile of ashes... / At home, I chased rats in the gutters—for food, not for sport. Here I sleep with my belly full each day. It is like paradise, you see. / We cannot rely on the Kiltias to provide everything for us. We must do what we can to help. / Ahead on the temple grounds, there's a viera, name of Relj. I'd heard her kind were frigid, but that one is made of ice. / ...You came through Golmore Jungle? Ah, yes, I see, you jape with me! We both know no viera would allow a hume to pass through their Wood. / More than ten thousand souls find peace on Mt Bur-Omisace. Our doors are open to all. The blessings of the gods be with you. Faram. / There's enough for all. Please, no pushing. / This place reeks of poverty. Tch, there's not a thing of value in the whole camp. ...Uh, what I just said, you didn't hear that. I'm a refugee too. They kick me out of here, I've no place to go. / Up from here are the temple grounds. Never been, myself. They don't feed you up there. / Ah, another refugee. I can see you're weary. Please, eat and rest. You are safe here. / Ah, a pilgrim. The temple grounds are ahead. The Light shine upon your path. Faram. / They say the Gran Kiltias Anastasis can silence a king, or even an emperor, with a single withering glare. What I want to know is, why does he hide up here on this mountain? He should be down there, stopping those warmongers. / See how many tents there are? There's more every day. I'm thinking to leave this place. The more people come, the less space there is for all.

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: My little emperor-in-waiting. You called and I have come.

This is the man I wanted you to meet. / Believe it or not, he is a member of the noble House Margrace, rulers of the Rozarrian Empire. / I am but one of very, very many. / Try as I might, I could not stop this war alone... / thus I came seeking Larsa's assistance.

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: Al-Cid Margrace, at your service.

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: To think I stand before the Lady Ashe. It is truly an honor.

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: I see it is true after all. Ah, stunning is Dalmasca's desert bloom.

speaker: Anastasis; Al-Cid; Ashe
line_text: In Archadia, Larsa. In Rozarria, Al-Cid. / They dream not of war. / Should empire join with empire, the way will open for a new Ivalice in our time. / Hah, Gran Kiltias! You speak much of dreams. But in the real world, war is upon us. / Gran Kiltias, I was told my coming here would prevent this war.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: I was to assume my father's throne and announce the restoration of Dalmasca... / treat with the Empire for peace, and persuade the Resistance to stay their hand. / I have not come all this way to be asked to reconsider!

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: A word from you and the Resistance would stop cold...

and Rozarria's pretext for joining the war... scattered, off to the four winds. / This was what we had hoped. Alas, circumstances change. / A full two years have passed since your reported death. / Were it to become known you were still alive... / I fear it could only worsen our current situation. / Because I am powerless to help.

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: Nay, in fact it has little to do with you.

speaker: Larsa
line_text: Then what?
If Lady Ashe were to extend her hand in friendship... / perhaps I could then persuade the Emperor. / His Excellency will solve things peacefully—

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: The Emperor Gramis is no more. / His life was taken.

speaker: Larsa
line_text: Father!

speaker: system message; no name shown
line_text: [value] leaves the party. (the game fills [value] with Larsa, party table row 13) / (empty string)

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: Let us suppose you approach the Empire with a peaceful resolution.
The late Emperor Gramis would have lent you his ear, that much is certain. / But we are dealing with Vayne Solidor.
Should the Princess return, he would claim her an impostor.
All to tempt the Resistance into battle.

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: Vayne wants this war, that much is certain. / As our ill luck would have it, the man is a military genius.

speaker: Anastasis
line_text: The dreams have told me thus. / To reveal yourself would imperil us all. / I see war, and Vayne's name writ bold on history's page.

Archadia's banners fly high. They are making ready for the coming war. / According to our latest reports... / The Western Armada prepares for war, under Vayne's command no less. / The newly formed 12th Fleet has already been deployed. / The Imperial 1st Fleet stands ready. They'll be under way as soon as the Odin's refit is complete. / And there is more: the 2nd Kerwon Expeditionary Force is being called in... / to replace the missing 8th, so there will be no gaps. / The largest force ever seen!

speaker: Ashe
line_text: And then...the nethicite is the coup de grâce. / Gran Kiltias, Your Grace. / I spoke to you of my succession. Let us put that aside.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Should I become Queen of Dalmasca now, powerless as I am, I can protect nothing.
With a greater power at my disposal, perhaps then. / It is the nethicite of which you dream?

speaker: Ashe
line_text: I require something far greater.

speaker: Anastasis
line_text: To wield power against power. / Truly the words of a hume-child.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: I am descended from the Dynast-King himself.

speaker: Anastasis
line_text: Indeed. Then you have but one choice. Seek you the other power Raithwall left.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: Does such a thing exist?

speaker: Anastasis
line_text: Journey across the Paramina Rift to the Stilshrine of Miriam. / There rests the gift he entrusted to the Gran Kiltias of his time. Seek it out.

speaker: Anastasis
line_text: The Sword of Kings...can cut through nethicite. / Why he would entrust the power to destroy nethicite, the instrument of his greatness... / to another and not to his own progeny, I cannot say.

speaker: Anastasis
line_text: Awaken Ashelia B'nargin and take up your sword, or your dream will remain but a dream.

speaker: Anastasis
line_text: My dream, too, fades into day.

speaker: Judge Bergan
line_text: Ah, our vagrant princess. / Swift has your lust for revenge led you to the Sword of Kings.

speaker: Judge Bergan
line_text: You will surrender it to me.
Too late, and to their sorrow do those who misplace their trust in gods learn their fate.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: There it is again.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Fran, I don't like the look of that.
This Mist— he holds a Stone! / It controls him as it did Mjrn!
No. / No, the power of manufacted nethicite is the power of Man!
A weapon forged by his wisdom... / who would challenge the gods themselves! / A fitting blade for a true Dynast-King.
Raithwall did but pretend the title... / a cur begging nethicite scraps from his master's table.
a cur begging nethicite scraps from his master's table.
Hark! / Ivalice hails her true Dynast-King, Vayne Solidor!
He shall defy the will of the gods, and see the reins of History back in the hands of Man!
His time is nigh!
The new Ivalice holds no place for the name Dalmasca. / The stain of Raithwall's blood...
shall be washed clean from history's weave!

speaker: Balthier
line_text: He set his very bones about with manufacted nethicite.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: The Gran Kiltias?

speaker: Penelo
line_text: Wait—what about Larsa?
Gone. Spirited away by Judge Gabranth.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: You okay?

speaker: Basch
line_text: So he was here.
Ah, as for our young lordling, he went along— to avoid trouble, you see.
But Judge Bergan had other ideas.
He flew into a rage, and I was left to fend for myself.
Please, Princess. You must permit me to take you back with me to Rozarria.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: So that you can protect me?
I would lay down my life at a single word to be sure... / but I harbor no maundering delusions of valiant grandeur.
Vayne has our War Pavilion jumping at shadows. They favor a preemptive strike.
But you—you will convince them otherwise.

speaker: Al-Cid
line_text: You will see that they do not start this war.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: This I cannot do. Forgive me. But my errand here is not yet done.

speaker: Ashe
line_text: I must wield the Sword of Kings, and with it bring an end to the Dusk Shard.
Ah, this Stone. Do you even know where it is?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: I can venture a guess.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: The Draklor Laboratory. In Archades. / The Empire's weapons research begins and ends there. / How soon do we leave?

speaker: Ashe
line_text: At once. / As for matters in Rozarria... I bid you luck.
So you would leave each to fend for his own. Let us hope that you are not disappointed.
Ah, that's right. Larsa left a message.
"The differences between our two lands will fade before the shared dream of men."
My leave I take.

actor: 読み込みイベント監督
line_text: How do you propose we reach Archades? / Archadia's borders will be well guarded for fear of Rozarrian invasion. / We dare not approach by air. / And their navy will see that the coast is watched as well... No, we go afoot. / We'll cross into Archadia in the Salikawood. / We can reach the wood any number of ways, but the easiest is to head north from Nalbina. / There is a hunter's camp just beyond the Salikawood. / The camp sits within Archadia's borders, so Imperial patrols there should be sparse. / Getting that far should be half the fun. Let's be sure we go prepared.
